metadata.title: BANGKOK 🇹🇭 Food Tour Series Starting on 3rd July 2024 ​⁠@delhifoodwalks YouTube Channel l Thailand
metadata.description:
#Bangkok #Bangkokfood #BangkokFoodTour

We are thrilled to unveil our upcoming Bangkok food series, a journey into the capital city of Thailand, where street food is a carnival of colour, flavors and aromas. It's a world where diversity meets affordability. During our visit to this popular tourist destination, we were deeply moved by the richness of its culinary offerings. Through eight captivating episodes, we invite you to experience the essence of Bangkok's street food. The series begins this Wednesday. Till then savour the trailer.


About the host:
https://anubhavsapra.com/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks

Design and filmed by Rahul Singh 
https://instagram.com/iamrahulsingh.2

Text by Swetaleena Nayak
